highlight.title: The Same Quips, Every Screen
highlight.summary: Version 2.0 is a native Mac app, a full iPad app, and the same Quips on your phone — plus a rebuilt Discover, attribution you can check, and undo for nearly everything.

points.title: A Native Mac App
points.detail: A sidebar, a toolbar, a menu bar, and windows of its own

releases.name: Quips Comes to the Mac and iPad
releases.summary: Quips is a native Mac app now — and on every device the layout follows the window instead of the hardware, so it's the same app whether it's a phone in your hand, an iPad in Split View, or a window on a desktop. Discover became a place of its own, quotes say how well they're attributed, and almost nothing you do is permanent anymore.

features.title: A Native Mac App
features.detail: Quips runs natively on the Mac rather than as an iPad app in a window — a sidebar and toolbar of its own, a full menu bar, a Settings window, and as many windows open at once as you like.

features.title: One Layout, Every Size
features.detail: The sidebar and the detail column appear wherever there's room for them, so the layout is decided by how wide the window is rather than which device you're holding. iPad gets the full split view, in portrait as well as landscape.

features.title: Everything in the Sidebar
features.detail: Collections, tags, authors and sources are created and managed straight from the sidebar, alongside Favorites, Discover, On This Day and Recently Deleted. It puts what you use most at the top, and you can choose what appears.

features.title: Built for the Keyboard
features.detail: Command-N for a new quote, Command-L to favorite, Command-F to search, arrow keys to move through the grid, and Command-Down to open a quote in a window of its own. Select several quotes at once, and find the full set on the new Keyboard Shortcuts screen.

features.title: Undo
features.detail: Change your mind. Deleting, writing, editing and favoriting a quote can all be undone — Command-Z on a keyboard, or a shake on iPhone.

features.title: Discover, Rebuilt
features.detail: Discover is somewhere you go now, on every platform. Search reaches the quotes themselves rather than just collection names, there's a featured collection each week, and you can share a quote you found without keeping it.

features.title: Attribution You Can See
features.detail: Every quote in Discover says how well its attribution is established — Verified, Widely attributed, Folk wisdom or Unconfirmed — on the card as well as on the quote's own screen.

features.title: Screens for Authors, Tags and Sources
features.detail: Authors, tags, sources and collections each have a detail screen that gathers everything filed under them, and has something to say about them.

features.title: A New Pin Format
features.detail: A 2:3 Pin format joins Square, Portrait, Story and Wide. On the Mac, Share Studio opens in a window of its own with the controls as an inspector.

features.title: Spotlight
features.detail: Your library is indexed for Spotlight, so searching your device by a phrase or an author's name finds what you've saved, and tapping a result opens it in Quips.

features.title: A New Default Look
features.detail: Quotes render in the Subtle style out of the box, the app is themed Cyan to match the icon, and the icon chooser now holds sixteen designs — including Chevron and Paper, which change more than the color.

releases.name: Widget Studio & Quote of the Day
releases.summary: Make your widgets your own, put a quote on your Lock Screen, and have quotes delivered exactly when you want them. Plus a lot more room on the free plan.

features.title: Widget Studio
features.detail: Design your Home Screen widgets in Settings → Widgets — customize the layout, background color and gradient, typeface, text color and alignment, and which details to show, with a live preview at every size.

features.title: Lock Screen Widget
features.detail: Put a quote on your Lock Screen, from your personal collections or from the Quote of the Day.

features.title: Quote of the Day
features.detail: Schedule quote notifications on your schedule. Customize the time, day, and frequency. Schedule one on the free plan; Premium unlocks up to ten.

features.title: A Brighter Palette
features.detail: All sixteen quote colors were recreated to be more vivid and to read well in both light and dark mode

features.title: On This Day
features.detail: See which quotes were said on today's date; pin them to your main screen, or use them as your Quote of the Day.

features.title: Add a Whole Collection at Once
features.detail: Curated public collections now have an "Add All to Library" button. So you can quickly add an entire collection to your library.

features.title: Quips Quest
features.detail: A fun checklist of first-time milestones that shows you around the app, with a special celebration when you complete them.

features.title: 100 Free Quotes
features.detail: The free plan now allows up to 100 quotes in your personal collections, so a full curated collection now fits comfortably.

releases.name: Quote Style & Share Studio

features.title: Quote Style

features.title: Share Studio

features.title: Source Types
features.detail: Note where a quote came from — book, movie, podcast, speech, and more — each shown with a matching icon

features.title: Copy Any Quote
features.detail: Press and hold a quote to copy it, along with its author and date

features.title: More Personalization
features.detail: New collection icons and colors, plus a new Salmon app icon (Premium)
